glosses: такой, о котором невозможно забыть, всегда сохраняющийся в памяти

examples.text: Всем вспомнилась моя милая, незабвенная красавица-мать.
Фотография появилась в октябрьский день, вскоре после первого, незабвенного выступления в шахматном клубе.

glosses: Very difficult or impossible to forget.

examples.text: The things he subjected me to were horrible and unforgettable.

He had never seen dogs fight as these wolfish creatures fought, and his first experience taught him an unforgetable lesson. It is true, it was a vicarious experience, else he would not have lived to profit by it.
The leading engine was one of the Class Y6 2-8-8-2 compound articulateds, [...] The stack noise of one of these great brutes slogging up a grade was quite unforgettable.

glosses: Worthy to be remembered; very important or remarkable.

examples.text:
Men have surviving Fame to gain,
By Tombs, by Books, by memorable Deeds

But Mr. Hunt hated the character immediately -- Elmo wasn't edgy enough -- and, on one memorable morning, brought him into the Muppeteers' lounge "hanging by the rods," the chopsticklike bars that control his paws.

glosses: Something interesting enough to be remembered.

examples.text: These were all the memorables of our visit to Dumbarton Castle, which is a most interesting spot, and connected with a long series of historical events.

glosses: Que no puede o no debe olvidarse.
che non può essere dimenticato perché legato ad un'emozione piacevole o spiacevole
